segments.he: אות א חייב אדם לישא אשה כדי לפרות ולרבות וכולי:
segments.en: For from the very beginning, the birth of Mashiach was [meant] to rectify this sin. For the beginning of the revelation of Mashiach was from Yehudah, who fathered Peretz and Zerach from Tamar, and they were a rectification for the sin of Er and Onan who corrupted their ways, as is known. And therefore Yehudah needed to draw down the aspect of the soul of Mashiach, through which they would be rectified, for the rectification of this sin is dependent on Mashiach, as mentioned above.

segments.he: כל המשפחות בחזקת כשרות וכולי, אף על פי כן אם ראית ב' משפחות שמתגרות זו בזו תמיד או ב' בני אדם שמתגרים זה בזה, או ראית משפחה שהיא בעלת מצה ומריבה תמיד או ראית איש שהוא מרבה מריבה עם הכל ועז פנים ביותר חוששין להם, וראוי להתרחק מהם שאלו סימני פסולות הם וכולי. וכן מי שיש בו עזות פנים ואכזריות ושונא את הבריות וכולי חוששין לו שמא גבעוני הוא עד כאן לשון שלחן ערוך סימן ב' סעיף ב':
segments.en: A Kohein, a Levi, and a Yisra’el are permitted to intermarry with one another, and the offspring follows the male:
segments.he_nikud: כָּל הַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת בְּחֶזְקַת כְּשֵׁרוֹת וְכוּ', אַף-עַל-פִּי-כֵן אִם רָאִיתָ שְׁתֵּי מִשְׁפָּחוֹת שֶׁמִּתְגָּרוֹת זוֹ בָּזוֹ תָּמִיד אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם שֶׁמִּתְגָּרִים זֶה בָּזֶה, אוֹ רָאִיתָ מִשְׁפָּחָה שֶׁהִיא בַּעֲלַת מַצָּה וּמְרִיבָה תָּמִיד, אוֹ רָאִיתָ אִישׁ שֶׁהוּא מַרְבֶּה מְרִיבָה עִם הַכֹּל וְעַז פָּנִים בְּיוֹתֵר, חוֹשְׁשִׁין לָהֶם וְרָאוּי לְהִתְרַחֵק מֵהֶם, שֶׁאֵלּוּ סִימָנֵי פְּסוּלוּת הֵם וְכוּ'. וְכֵן מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ עַזּוּת פָּנִים וְאַכְזָרִיּוּת וְשׂוֹנֵא אֶת הַבְּרִיּוֹת וְכוּ', חוֹשְׁשִׁין לוֹ שֶׁמָּא גִּבְעוֹנִי הוּא. עַד כָּאן לְשׁוֹן שֻׁלְחָן עָרוּךְ סִימָן ב סָעִיף ב:

segments.he: נמצא שעיקר פסול המשפחה הוא על ידי עזות דסטרא אחרא, שכל משפחה שרואין בהם שהם עזי פנים ביותר ובעלי ריב ומצה צריכין להתרחק מהם שלא לישא מהם. וזה מבואר על פי התורה חותם בתוך חותם בסימן כ"ב. מבואר שם שעיקר התרחקות מהקדושה הוא על ידי העזי פנים שבדור שהם מתגברין ביותר להרחיק מצדיקי אמת שהם בחינת השבעה רועים שכל המשכת האמונה הקדושה הוא על ידם, על כן אי אפשר להתקרב אל הקדושה כי אם על ידי עזות דקדושה, שצריך כל אדם שיהיה לו עזות דקדושה כדי שיוכל לעמוד נגד עזותם הרע של העזי פנים שנוטלים הממשלה לעצמן, כי עזות מלכותא בלא תגא וכולי עיין שם. ועזות הוא בחינת קולות, בחינת הן יתן בקולו קול עוז, ולבא לעזות הוא על ידי שמחה שזוכין על ידי שני הכתרים שהם בחינת נעשה ונשמע, שהם בחינת תורה ותפלה נגלה ונסתר וכולי, בחינת בראשית ברא אב ובן וכולי. וצריך כל אדם לילך מדרגא לדרגא וכולי עד שיהיה נכלל בתחילת נקודת הבריאה וכולי, ואחר כך כשנכלל באין סוף שם התורה היא תורת ה' ממש, ובתפילה היא תפילת ה' ממש עיין שם. וקודם שיוצאין ועולין מדרגא לדרגא צריך שיהיה לו ירידה קודם העליה, כי הירידה היא תכלית העליה וכולי, עיין שם כל זה היטב:
segments.en: For it is brought in the Torah “Tik’u 3” which speaks of rebuke (in Likutay Tinyana, Siman 8), that the essential tefillah is compassion and supplications, and the essential compassion depends on da’as (knowledge/awareness), etc. And sometimes, when they [the forces of the Other Side] suckle from the compassion, then the compassion is blemished and becomes cruelty, and then the da’as is blemished, etc.; see there. And from this comes, G-d forbid, the desire of adultery, for the essential desire comes through the blemish of da’as. For the brain is a partition spread out before this desire, for there are three brains, and from them are drawn three kinds of compassion, which are the aspect of three tefillos (prayers) per day. And each of the three brains is the aspect of a partition spread out before this desire, etc.; see there.

segments.he: כי עיקר הבריאה היתה בשביל האמונה הקדושה שעל ידה יודעין ממנו יתברך שבשביל זה נברא הכל כידוע. וזה גודל החיוב לישא אשה כדי לפרות ולרבות בשביל קיום העולם, כדי שיתגלה אמונתו ומלכותו על ידי ריבוי בני אדם שבכל דור ודור, כי צריכין להמשיך האמונה הקדושה מדור לדור כמו שכתוב: ועד דור ודור אמונתו, לדור ודור אמונתך כוננת ארץ ותעמוד, שעיקר בריאת וקיום העולם שכונן ארץ ותעמוד הוא בשביל לדור ודור אמונתך שימשיכו האמונה מדור לדור. ועל כן הזהירו חז"ל להתרחק ביותר מעזי פנים מלישא מהם כנ"ל, כי העזי פנים מרחיקין מהאמונה הקדושה, כי הם המונעים הגדולים מלהתקרב לצדיקי אמת שמהם עיקר המשכת האמונה הקדושה, ועל כן בודאי אסור לישא מהם, כי עיקר הנשואין הוא בשביל להמשיך האמונה הקדושה מדור לדור כנ"ל:
segments.en: And then the tefillah is in the aspect of din (judgment), etc. And then one needs a person of great power who can pray tefillah in the aspect of din, like Pinchas at the time of the deed of Zimri, etc. For this tefillah of the man of great power stands at the throat of the Sitra Achara until it is compelled to vomit forth all the tefillos and the holinesses that it swallowed, in the aspect of: “The wealth he swallowed he shall vomit up” (Iyov 20:15), etc. And this is the aspect of: “You broke apart the sea with Your might; You shattered the heads of the sea-serpents upon the waters” (Tehillim 74:13), the aspect of: “For the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Hashem, as the waters cover the sea” (Yeshayah 11:9), etc. And this is the aspect of ananei d’shafchei maya (clouds that pour forth water), etc.; see there all of this very well.

segments.he: ועל כן עיקר המלחמה של האדם הוא בענין תאוה זאת, כי שם העיקר העזות דקדושה בחינת בו עז_בו תוקפא, ושורשו נמשך מקדושה העליונה מבחינת שני הכתרים הנ"ל שהם נעשה ונשמע, תורה ותפלה נסתר ונגלה וכולי שהם בחינת בראשית ברא. כי שני הכתרים הנ"ל הם בחינת חמה ולבנה בחינת איש ואשה שהם בחינת תורה ותפילה כידוע, שמשם נמשך עזות דקדושה שעל ידי זה עיקר המשכת האמונה הקדושה כנ"ל, אבל זה לעומת זה עשה האלקים על כן שם עיקר אחיזת העזות דסטרא אחרא, על כן הוא מלחמה גדולה:
segments.en: And this is the aspect of Kohein, Levi, Yisra’el, which are the essential holiness of the yichus (lineage) of Israel. For Israel, a holy nation, must guard themselves that their unions should be in holiness and in purity, for this is the essential holiness of Israel — to guard oneself from the blemish of the desire of adultery, as is known. And therefore they must guard themselves that their unions should be in great holiness, and that there should not be attached to them, G-d forbid, the aspect of the aforementioned desire.

segments.he: וזה בחינת שמחת חתן וכלה שהוא מצוה לשמחם כמו שאמרו רז"ל, כי על ידי שמחה זוכין לעזות דקדושה בחינת כי חדות ה' היא מעוזכם כמו שכתוב שם. וזה בחינת מה שאמרו רז"ל: כל מי שנהנה מסעודת חתן וכלה ואינו משמחם עובר בה' קולות וכולי, כי כל הקולות הם בחינת עזות כנ"ל, ועיקר השמחה של חתן וכלה הוא בשביל הקולות הקדושים שהם בחינת עזות דקדושה, כדי שיזכו להגביר העזות דקדושה על העזות דסטרא אחרא, כדי שיזכו על ידי זה להמשיך האמונה הקדושה שבשביל זה עיקר מצות הנישואין כנ"ל. וזה בחינת שבעת ימי המשתה שבהם משמחין חתן וכלה, וזה בחינת שבעה ברכות כדי להמשיך על ידי השמחה שהוא בחינת עזות דקדושה בחינת קולות דקדושה, להמשיך על ידי זה קדושת השבעה רועים שעל ידם עיקר המשכת האמונה הקדושה כמו שכתוב שם עיין שם, ועל כן הם שבעת ימי המשתה כנגד השבעה רועים הנ"ל. וזה בחינת עזות דקדושה שמברכין אותן בכל ז' ימי המשתה, כדי להמשיך קדושת השבעה רועים שעל ידם עיקר המשכת האמונה הקדושה כנ"ל, כי האמונה היא בחינת ברכות, כי הוא מקור הברכות כמו שכתוב איש אמונות רב ברכות כמבואר במדרש אגדה:
segments.en:
And the essential guarding from the blemish of this desire is through the three brains, which are partitions spread out before this desire, as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of Kohein, Levi, Yisra’el, which are the aspect of the three brains — Chochmah, Binah, Da’as — as is known, which are the aspect of partitions spread out before this desire. And therefore the essential holiness of the union of Israel is through the aspect of Kohein, Levi, Yisra’el, which are the essential boundary of holy lineage. For only they alone can unite in holiness as is fitting, so that there should not be attached to their union, G-d forbid, the blemish of the desire of adultery. For Kohein, Levi, Yisra’el are the aspect of the aforementioned three brains, which are the aspect of partitions spread out before this desire. And therefore the essential boundary of holy lineage is Kohein, Levi, Yisra’el, as is explained in the Mishnah and Shulchan Aruch, as mentioned above.

And this is why our Sages, of blessed memory, gave a sign regarding a proper family — when it is not given to strife and contention. But a family that is given to strife and contention — this is a sign that there is a blemish of lineage in it, as is brought in the Shulchan Aruch. For compassion depends on da’as, as mentioned above in the aforementioned teaching, and one who has no compassion has no da’as.

And therefore a family that is given to strife and contention, which is the aspect of anger and harsh judgments, the opposite of compassion — it is certainly not fitting for the seed of Israel to unite with them, and there is certainly a blemish of lineage in them. For the essential holiness of the lineage of Israel is that they are compassionate ones, children of compassionate ones — which is the aspect of da’as, which is the essential holiness of their lineage, the aspect of Kohein, Levi, Yisra’el, the three brains, which are the essential holiness of the bris, as mentioned above. But one who is a person of contention, which is the opposite of compassion, which is a blemish of da’as — it is not fitting to intermarry with him, for he is in the aspect of the blemish of the desire of adultery, which depends on the blemish of da’as, which is the blemish of compassion, which is the opposite of the holiness of Kohein, Levi, Yisra’el, as mentioned above. And therefore there is certainly a blemish of lineage in him and it is forbidden to intermarry with him, for the essential thing depends on compassion, which is the aspect of da’as, which is the partition spread out before this desire, as mentioned above.

And therefore it is forbidden for us to intermarry and to unite with all the nations, for they are all in the aspect of cruelty and din (harsh judgment), for they are compared to wild beasts — the aspect of cruelty and harsh judgments, which is the blemish of da’as, from which comes the aforementioned desire. And therefore it is forbidden for Israel to intermarry with them, for the essential union of Israel must be specifically in the aspect of compassion and da’as, which is the partition spread out before the desire, in order that the union should be in holiness as is fitting, as mentioned above.

And therefore there are nations that even when they convert are forbidden to enter the congregation of Hashem. This is because the cruelty and the din have become so attached to them that they cannot be included within the compassion and the da’as, which is the aspect of the holiness of Israel, even when they convert.

And this is what our Sages, of blessed memory, said: the Nesinim (Gibeonites) — David decreed upon them, because they had no compassion at all, as is brought there. He said: There are three signs in this nation — they are compassionate, they are modest, and they perform acts of kindness. Whoever has these three signs is fit to cleave to [Israel], and whoever does not have these three signs is not fit to cleave to [Israel]. That is, as mentioned above — for it is not fitting to cleave to the congregation of Hashem, to the holy seed of Israel, except for one who is included within compassion, which is the aspect of da’as. But one who has no compassion, such as the Nesinim, is forbidden to enter the congregation of Hashem, for the blemish of compassion is the blemish of da’as, which is the aspect of the desire of adultery. For the holy union of Israel must be separated from the blemish of this desire, as mentioned above.

And this is why our Sages, of blessed memory, enumerated three qualities: modest, compassionate, and performers of acts of kindness. They are the aspect of the aforementioned three brains, which are the aspect of the three kinds of compassion, etc., as mentioned above. For modesty too is the aspect of da’as and compassion, for the essential modesty depends on da’as, as it says: “They were also not ashamed, neither did they know how to blush” (Yirmiyah 6:15). For the animal, which has no da’as, has no shame. And as is also understood in the words of Rabbeinu, of blessed memory, elsewhere, in the teaching “Markevos Par’oh V’Cheilo” (Siman 38), that shame depends on da’as. Also, shame is the aspect of compassion, the opposite of brazenness, which is the aspect of g’vuros and harsh judgments.

It follows that all the three aforementioned qualities — modest, compassionate, and performers of acts of kindness — are three qualities of compassion, corresponding to the aspect of the three kinds of compassion mentioned above that come from the three brains, as mentioned above, upon which the essential holiness of the union of Israel depends. And whoever is not included in these three qualities of compassion is forbidden to enter the congregation of Hashem. And therefore it was specifically because of this that the Nesinim were forbidden to enter the congregation, as mentioned above.

And this is the aspect of the prohibition of niddah (menstrual impurity). For the blood of niddah is the aspect of the intense din (harsh judgment) that comes from the contamination of the serpent. And then the union is forbidden, as mentioned above. And the essential tikkun and purification from the blood of niddah, or of the gentiles when they convert and wish to enter the congregation, is through immersion in a mikveh. For the mikveh is the aspect of the waters of da’as and compassion, through which comes the essential purification. For the essential prohibition of the blood of niddah, or of uniting with gentiles, is on account of the intensity of din, which is the contamination of the serpent, as mentioned above. And therefore through the mikveh, which is the aspect of the waters of da’as and compassion, they are purified, as mentioned above.

For the essential tikkun when the desire of adultery intensifies through the aspect of harsh judgments, G-d forbid, is through the tefillah of the man of great power, through which he extracts all the da’as and the compassion that the Sitra Achara has swallowed, in the aspect of: “The wealth he swallowed he shall vomit up.” And then the da’as is revealed, in the aspect of: “For the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Hashem, as the waters cover the sea.” And this is the aspect of ananei d’shafchei maya (clouds that pour forth water), etc., the aspect of thunder, etc.; see there well in the aforementioned teaching.

And this is the aspect of the waters of the mikveh, which are the aspect of the waters of da’as and compassion that are revealed through the aspect of thunder, through which rains come, the aspect of ananei d’shafchei maya. And from these waters is made the mikveh, where they are purified from the contamination of the serpent, from the aforementioned blemish that comes from the blemish of compassion, etc., as mentioned above. For the essential tikkun is through this, as is understood in the aforementioned teaching; understand well.

And this is the aspect of the wells that Yitzchak dug, as it is written: “And Yitzchak returned and dug the wells of water that they had dug in the days of Avraham his father, and the Philistines had stopped them up” (Bereishis 26:18). For in truth, the digging of the wells is the aspect of the revelation of da’as, in the aspect of: “For the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Hashem, as the waters cover the sea,” as mentioned above. And the essential revelation of the waters of da’as, which is the aspect of wells of water, is through chesed (kindness), the aspect of Avraham. For da’as is the aspect of compassion, as is explained in the aforementioned teaching. And therefore Avraham dug the wells.

But all the wells that were dug in the days of Avraham — the Philistines stopped them up and filled them with earth. For sometimes they [the forces of the Other Side] suckle from the compassion, and then the compassion is blemished and the da’as is blemished, as mentioned above in the aforementioned teaching. For in the days of Avraham, the contamination of the serpent had not yet been fully refined, as is brought. And therefore Yishma’el came forth from him.

And therefore the tikkun was through Yitzchak, for Yitzchak is the aspect of din (judgment) and he is the aspect of tefillah in the aspect of din, as it is written: “And Yitzchak went out to converse in the field toward evening” (Bereishis 24:63) — for he instituted the afternoon prayer, as our Sages, of blessed memory, said — which is the aspect of tefillah in the aspect of din. And through this specifically one extracts all the vitality, etc., from the Sitra Achara, and the waters of da’as are revealed, etc., in the aspect of: “For the earth shall be full of the knowledge, as the waters,” etc., in the aspect of: “You broke apart the sea with Your might; You shattered the heads of the sea-serpents upon the waters,” as mentioned above in the aforementioned teaching.

And therefore Yitzchak rectified the wells, which are the aspect of the revelation of the da’as of Avraham that the Philistines had damaged, as mentioned above. And Yitzchak, who is the aspect of tefillah in the aspect of din, rectified this, in the aspect of: “And Yitzchak returned and dug the wells of water,” etc. For the essential tikkun is through the aspect of Yitzchak, etc., as mentioned above.

And this is the aspect of why we mention the might of the rains in the blessing of “You are mighty” (Atah Gibor). For they are called g’vuros g’shamim (the might of the rains), because the rains, which are the waters of da’as, come specifically through the aspect of the might of Yitzchak, through the aspect of tefillah in the aspect of din, through which da’as is revealed, as mentioned above. For through this come the thunders, the aspect of ananei d’shafchei maya, as mentioned above.

And this is the aspect of the mikveh, which is the aspect of the waters of da’as that come through the aforementioned tikkun. For the mikveh is made through rainwater, which is the aspect of g’vuros g’shamim, or from a well and a spring, which are the aspect of the wells of Yitzchak. For specifically through the aspect of the might of Yitzchak are the waters of da’as and compassion revealed, the aspect of the mikveh, as mentioned above. And this is the essential tikkun, for it is the aspect of tefillah in the aspect of din of the man of great power, as mentioned above in the aforementioned teaching. And therefore through this specifically they are purified from the contamination of the serpent, etc., as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of the immersion in the mikveh, whether of the niddah or of the gentiles when they convert. For through this they emerge from the aspect of din, which is the contamination of the serpent, the blemish of the desire of adultery, and they are included in the totality of compassion and da’as, upon which the essential holiness of the union depends, as mentioned above.

And therefore the Kohein, who is the aspect of the ultimate compassion and da’as — as is brought, that the Kohein is the aspect of great chesed (kindness), for the Kohein is the first of the three aforementioned brains, of the three aforementioned kinds of compassion — therefore the Kohein is warned even more regarding the holiness of the union, and must distance himself from the aspect of din more and more. And even among Israelites themselves, wherever there is any hold of din whatsoever, she is forbidden to him.

And this is the aspect of those disqualified for the Kehunah (priesthood), which are: a divorcee, a zonah (harlot), and a chalalah (profaned woman) — all of whom are in the aspect of din. And even though they are of the seed of Israel and are in truth permitted to a [regular] Yisra’el, nevertheless, since there is a hold of din in them, they are therefore forbidden to a Kohein, who is the ultimate of compassion and da’as, as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of a captive woman, who is forbidden to a Kohein. For since din has taken hold of her to the point that she came into captivity, she is therefore forbidden to the Kohein, who is the ultimate of compassion. For the essential holiness of the union depends on the aspect of compassion, which is the aspect of da’as, as mentioned above.

And this is the aspect of: Pinchas did not become a Kohein until he killed Zimri. For through his killing of Zimri, Pinchas then effected the tikkun through tefillah in the aspect of din, as is explained in the aforementioned teaching, in the aspect of: “And Pinchas stood up and prayed” (Tehillim 106:30). And then, specifically through this, the ultimate compassion and da’as was revealed, the aspect of ananei d’shafchei maya (clouds that pour forth water) — which is the aspect of the waters of the mikveh, which is the ultimate of compassion and da’as that is revealed specifically through the aspect of the might of Yitzchak, as mentioned above.

And therefore Pinchas then merited the Kehunah, which is the ultimate of compassion. For specifically through tefillah in the aspect of din of the man of great power, like Pinchas, is the essential tikkun effected. And then specifically comes the essential revelation of compassion and da’as, through which converts are made, and thunders are made, the aspect of ananei d’shafchei maya — that is, the waters of da’as and compassion. And through this one merits the aspect of “a river goes forth from Eden” (Bereishis 2:10), which is the aspect of the voice of the worthy reprover, through which everything is purified and rectified, speedily in our days, Amein.

Halacha 3 — In Hilchos Pirya V’Rivya, Halacha 3, from Oas Tes-Zayin onward.
